{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Score That Refuses To Mourn","laconic":"Soundtrack withholds sentiment as a deliberate authorial stance.","note":"Each reading treats musical detachment—breezy, indifferent, indie-pop, withheld—as a calculated refusal of feeling that the film authors on purpose. The score becomes a strategy of disavowal or engineered catharsis rather than emotional accompaniment.","members":[0,1,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Time Loop As Compulsion To Repeat Guilt","laconic":"The temporal loop is the symptom of unmetabolized shame.","note":"Each reading recasts the loop or paradox not as physics but as psychic sentence — guilt, shame, sacrifice. The self-execution in Looper completes the figure: the loop ends only when the debt is paid.","members":[0,1,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Festivity As Manic Defence Against Death","laconic":"Dancing and games shield the psyche from unbearable annihilation.","note":"Each reading casts celebration — dancing, betting, eros — as a manic defence warding off an unmournable death or appetite. The festive surface is the symptom of what cannot be faced.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Colonized Labor That Sings Its Bondage","laconic":"Imported musical workers voice the empire that owns them.","note":"Each reading hears the cheerful song-and-dance number as the colonial repressed returning through the bodies of an imported workforce. The performance itself becomes the alibi and the symptom of bondage.","members":[0,1,3]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Recession Rendered As Drained Color","laconic":"Films whose desaturated palette is read as the 2008 crash made visible.","note":"Each reading treats a bled-out, grey, or monochrome image as the direct visual signature of economic collapse and a cinema without capital or inheritance. The 2008 crash becomes weather, color, and atmosphere across these films.","members":[2,3,5,6,7]},{"name":"The Maker Working Against His Industry","laconic":"An auteur's personal vision set in opposition to commercial cinema.","note":"Both readings cast their filmmaker as a holdout—Curtis's eternal-sunshine England, Gray's last melodramatist—crafting against the prevailing grain of their industry.","members":[0,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Death Eroticized In Mishima's Aesthetic Key","laconic":"Beauty, violence, and death fused into a single lethal rapture.","note":"These readings invoke a Mishima-flavored aestheticism where killing and dying become objects of erotic, cultivated beauty. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Trauma That Resists Representation","laconic":"Catastrophe that cannot be staged, symbolized, or narrated.","note":"Each reading locates a wound that exceeds the image's capacity to depict it — history or loss erupting as the unrepresentable Real rather than as narrative. The shared move is the limit of representation itself.","members":[0,1,2,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"New Zealand Wearing Another World's Face","laconic":"The real landscape conscripted to perform a fictional or foreign geography.","note":"Each reading reads New Zealand's terrain as a stage-set — Middle-earth's Eden or a Texan dust bowl — foregrounding the nation's land as a body costumed for someone else's myth. The code is the recognized, branded substrate beneath the imagined place.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Prisoner Who Self-Taught His Way Free","laconic":"Confinement schools the autodidact who turns learning into escape.","note":"Each figure is captive—jail, slavery, station—and seizes the oppressor's literacy or doctrine as a weapon of liberation. The stolen book, the mastered tongue, the self-built theology: education as insurrection.","members":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The State Must Manufacture The Guilt It Punishes","laconic":"Bureaucratic power fabricates the very failure or guilt it then destroys.","note":"Each reading sees the state not as responding to crime or failure but as producing it, requiring a guilty or failed subject before it can exercise its cruelty. The shared move is that culpability is an institutional manufacture, not a fact the system discovers.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Disciple Who Betrays The Master's Faith","laconic":"Psychoanalysis as church; Jung's break from Freud as doctrinal heresy.","note":"All three read the Freud-Jung rupture as a religious schism — the master defending orthodoxy, the disciple turning apostate. The science is reframed as faith, the break as heresy.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Stranger's Sun: Camus's Indifferent Killer","laconic":"Murder under a blank, motiveless, Meursault-like sun.","note":"These readings cast the killer as Camus's Meursault — affectless, sun-glared, indifferent to the act. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Self Used As A Means","laconic":"Kant's Formula of Humanity turned inward against the self.","note":"Each reading invokes the categorical imperative — treating persons never merely as means — but redirects it at the self, whether as bait, body double, or split being. The shared move is reading self-instrumentalization as the ethical fault line.","members":[0,1,2,4,5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Films Clocked To Brazil's Wounded Political Calendar","laconic":"Each reading dates the film to a Brazilian historical rupture.","note":"These readings refuse to treat the film as timeless, instead pinning it to a precise moment of Brazilian authoritarian violence or its reckoning — the vote, the re-opened wound, the generals' twilight. The film becomes a seismograph of its political year.","members":[0,1,4]},{"name":"The Sertão's Vanished Men Become Code","laconic":"The disappeared dissident and sound-hunter as figures of erasure.","note":"Two readings of The Secret Agent recast its protagonists as ciphers for Brazil's engineer-dissidents and archivist-fugitives — the technologist and the sound-hunter as the politically vanished, surviving as trace.","members":[2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Medea's Shadow Over The Murderous Mother","laconic":"The maternal-killing myth invoked as interpretive lens.","note":"Each reading reaches for Medea (or Oedipal proof) to frame mothers bound to filicide, fury, or survival past the self. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Door That Brings Death","laconic":"Hitmen at the threshold; doom arrives as a visitor.","note":"Both readings fixate on The Killers' opening as a coded arrival of menace — the iceberg withholding what the knock at the door promises. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Screen That Indicts Its Watcher","laconic":"The viewer is conscripted into guilt, denied innocent spectatorship.","note":"Each reading turns the act of watching into an accusation, refusing the audience the alibi of passive innocence. The film addresses, implicates, or wagers against the spectator until complicity is inescapable.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Double Who Courts Her Own Exposure","laconic":"The mirrored self provokes the danger she pretends to flee.","note":"Both readings treat Clare as a returned, buried self whose surveillance and craving for capture are the same drive. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Excess Engineered To Defeat Its Era","laconic":"Sion Sono's maximalism as deliberate weapon against industrial constraint.","note":"Both readings frame runaway length and intensity not as indulgence but as strategy—excess built to survive the economic logic of its moment, whether post-bubble independence or algorithmic streaming. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Closet As Regime, Disclosure As Force","laconic":"Visibility and outing read through the closet's coercive architecture.","note":"Each reading frames queer selfhood against a regime of concealment—where coming out is moral act, survival tactic, weaponized cruelty, violence, or generational wound. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mask That Consumes Its Wearer","laconic":"Performed identity metastasizes until the self beneath dissolves.","note":"Each reading treats the assumed face — undercover persona, idol image, performed self — not as a covering but as a devouring agent. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Censorship Inscribed Into The Image Itself","laconic":"State or institutional repression becomes the film's visual grammar.","note":"Each reading argues that prohibition—surveillance, the Decency Code, evasion—doesn't merely constrain the film but is encoded into its very aesthetic surface. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Castaway As Self-Authoring Fabulist","laconic":"Survival becomes the deliberate composition of a livable fiction.","note":"Both readings recast Pi's ordeal not as endurance but as authorship — the survivor who narrates himself into being. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Praise That Reveals Its Own Reduction","laconic":"Acclaim that flattens a slippery text into legible allegory.","note":"Each reading turns critical praise into evidence against itself — the act of celebrating an 'allegory' exposes the audience's need to make the strange legible, betraying what the film resisted.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Philadelphia, City Of Brotherly Love Betrayed","laconic":"The name promises fellowship the city cannot deliver.","note":"Both readings turn the city's etymology against it, reading Philadelphia as a place whose name indicts its failure of brotherhood. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Archive That Outlives Its Keeper","laconic":"Borges's infinite library; the custodian dissolves into what he guarded.","note":"Two readings stage the archive as a labyrinth that consumes its keeper — one as infinite unjust library, one as custodian merging with his charge. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The File Is The Real Body Politic","laconic":"Bureaucratic paper as the true substance of crime and truth.","note":"These readings all locate reality, guilt, and power not in persons but in documents, archives, and filing systems—the paper trail as the secret protagonist. The wager and the misrecognition are the recurring move.","members":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The City Named To Indict The Nation","laconic":"A single city's name stands trial for the whole country.","note":"Each reading treats 'Nashville' as a synecdoche that conflates place and nation into one diagnosable, decentered body politic. The city becomes a mirror held up to America's symptoms.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Table As Domestic Battlefield","laconic":"Pialat's dinner table staged as Strindbergian war.","note":"Two readings frame the family table as a site of combat, with Pialat's own presence as father weaponizing the camera's flinch. The shared furniture of conflict binds them.","members":[1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Love As An Unrepayable, Tyrannical Debt","laconic":"To love or be loved is to owe what cannot be returned.","note":"Each reading recasts love not as exchange but as asymmetry — a debt incurred, a tyranny imposed, a refusal foreclosed. The creator owes the loved being, the beloved is enslaved, the partner cannot say no.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Frame That Cannot Contain","laconic":"The narrative frame breaches, failing to enclose or shelter its story.","note":"Both readings treat the diegetic frame not as boundary but as porous, failing structure — the book with no outside, the frame as inadequate shelter. The device's expected function (containment) is precisely what collapses.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Woman Who Chooses Power Over Rescue","laconic":"She declines the romance plot to command her own hierarchy.","note":"Each reading refuses the damsel/love-interest frame, casting the woman as a figure of command who outranks or discards her would-be saviors. Leia outranks her rescuers; Qi'ra ascends the syndicate rather than be carried by the romance.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Father Who Devours The Daughter He Loves","laconic":"Paternal love curdles into possession, control, and the dread of her desire.","note":"These readings share one code: the father whose love for the daughter is indistinguishable from a will to possess or consume her, often triggered by her emerging autonomy or desire. Aguirre's dynastic fantasy, Kaguya's smothering father, Triton's jealousy, and Fujimoto's terror all enact the same devouring paternal grip; even Thanos murders to keep what he loves.","members":[0,1,2,4,5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Adaptation That Confesses Its Own Limit","laconic":"Films staging the friction between literary source and cinematic form.","note":"Each reading treats adaptation not as transfer but as a self-aware negotiation with the medium's boundary—where authorship, framing, or fidelity becomes the visible problem. The unifying code is the film registering literature's resistance to becoming cinema.","members":[0,1,2,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Ecstasy That Cannot Tell Saint From Sinner","laconic":"Religious rapture and carnal desire collapse into one indistinguishable swoon.","note":"Both readings invoke the Baroque conflation of sacred ecstasy and erotic obsession, where mystical transport and sexual compulsion wear the same face. Bernini's Teresa is the explicit hinge, but both films stage faith and lust as a single unresolved knot.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Practical Effects Confessing CGI's Anxiety","laconic":"Tactile gore and globules staged as rebuke to digital artifice.","note":"Each reading frames physical, hand-made effects as a polemic against the CGI era — gore, slime, and shattering glass as the medium's anxious self-defense. The Jurassic entry is the strongest stretch but still confesses the same digital unease.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Horror Authored by the Craftsman, Not the Monster","laconic":"Dread engineered by director and design, never by the creature itself.","note":"Each reading relocates the source of fear from the ostensible supernatural or monstrous threat to the human craft behind the camera — direction, set-building, practical method. The terror is a thing built, not summoned.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Who Owns the Story of a Life","laconic":"A life's narration as contested property between authorship and kinship.","note":"Both readings frame Polley's film as a struggle over the right to author a shared life, pitting individual claim against relational obligation. The code is ownership-of-narrative as a site of conflict.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Camera As Nonhuman Gaze","laconic":"The lens belongs to animal, cosmos, or Being itself.","note":"These readings claim the camera's eye is not a person's but a creature's, the world's, or existence's own seeing. The deer's-eye, the dove's gaze, and Being's untethered look all decenter the human viewpoint.","members":[1,2,4]},{"name":"The Deer As The Wild Crossing The Threshold","laconic":"The animal arrives bearing the nature humans pushed out.","note":"The deer returns as the excluded wild made visible — once behind glass, now stepping back across the boundary into the human frame.","members":[0,5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Star Cast As His Own Obsolescence","laconic":"An actor's role becomes the public death of his era.","note":"Each reading collapses performer and industry, making the aging star embody the very system fading beneath him. Even the 'Roman exile' line reads Dalton as displaced relic of a dying Hollywood order.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The City That Refuses To Stage Its Past","laconic":"Marseille filmed as itself, defeating period romance and imposed history.","note":"A code where the real, present-day port-city asserts itself against the fiction laid over it — refusing to play the past, defeating the romance above with the steel below. The location is a stubborn protagonist, not a backdrop.","members":[2,4,5]},{"name":"The Mediterranean as Ledger of the Drowned","laconic":"The sea read as the space migration and history left vacant.","note":"Here the Mare Nostrum and the refugee in untenseable time mark the Mediterranean as an absence — a gap left behind, a history that cannot conjugate the living. The sea is wound, not setting.","members":[0,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Donor's Heart Indicts The Recipient","laconic":"A borrowed heart becomes the film's moral organ.","note":"Both readings hinge on the transplanted heart of Vice—one as narrator, one as the life Cheney lives on. The literal organ becomes the device for judging the man.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mother Stretched To Breaking","laconic":"Elasticity as the working mother's impossible, distended labor.","note":"Both readings convert Elastigirl's superpower into the literal body of maternal overextension — the stretch that names the second shift. A single, precise code shared across the two films.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Open Space That Is The Cell","laconic":"Exposed public spaces revealed as total surveillance apparatus.","note":"Each reading inverts spatial intuition: the open, airy, visible place — rooftop, plaza, kitchen, courtyard — becomes the most perfectly surveilled enclosure, the panopticon disguised as freedom.","members":[0,1,2,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Long Take That Outlasts Death","laconic":"Angelopoulos's unbroken shot dissolves the cut between living and dead, present and past.","note":"Both readings find in the uninterrupted sequence shot a refusal of montage's separations—of time, of mortality, of historical eras. The continuous take itself becomes the time-image, holding the dead alongside the living within one breathing frame.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Title's Heat Names A Lethal Threshold","laconic":"Heat as the temperature at which selves, loves, and pressures combust.","note":"Each reading treats thermal language in the title as a threshold-code: a point at which desire turns fatal, the self vanishes, or pressure cooks everyone. The heat is never weather—it is a measured limit being crossed.","members":[0,1,2,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Tone That Indicts Its Watcher","laconic":"The film's slipperiness is bait, sprung on the laughing viewer.","note":"Each reading treats tonal instability as a deliberate snare: the camp, the laughter, the mismatch are not lapses but a trap closing on the audience that took them at face value. The film weaponizes its own surface against those who enjoy it wrong.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Beauty Canonized To Disavow The Perversion","laconic":"Critics enshrine surface elegance to suppress the work's moral rot.","note":"Each reading indicts the critical establishment for aestheticizing a film's gorgeous surface precisely to avoid confronting its perverse, anesthetic, or narcissistic core. The cult of beauty becomes an alibi for not seeing.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Color As The Excess Symbolic Order Cannot Contain","laconic":"Chromatic eruption marks what representation and law fail to govern.","note":"Each reading treats a sudden burst of color as a rupture exceeding the symbolic, ideological, or representational order — sovereignty, ideology, the Real, the limit of the image. The shared move is color-as-excess that signification cannot domesticate.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Athlete As Discarded State Machine","laconic":"The engineered champion outlives the regime that built and abandoned him.","note":"Each reading casts the strongman not as enemy but as instrument — a body forged by a state, then left as wreckage once the empire that wielded it collapses. The pathos is in obsolescence, not ideology.","members":[0,1,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Survival Reduced To The Grain Of Rice","laconic":"Combat and war recast as the bare economy of eating.","note":"Each reading converts martial spectacle into a struggle over subsistence — rice, hunger, the privatized fight to keep eating. The heroic frame is stripped to the metabolic stakes beneath it.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Who Holds The Right To Narrate Chile","laconic":"Chilean cinema contesting who authors the national story.","note":"These readings interrogate narrative authority over Chilean history — police versus poet, exile versus archive, the silenced mouth. Each asks who is licensed to speak the nation.","members":[0,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Withholding As The Film's Whole Method","laconic":"What the film refuses to show becomes its governing form.","note":"Each reading treats deliberate withholding — of an event, an answer, a body, a cut — as the structuring principle rather than a mere technique. The absence is the argument.","members":[0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Death Written As Sentence Already Ending","laconic":"Mortality framed as authorship: life as a sentence finishing itself.","note":"These readings treat dying as a textual act — the author closing a chapter, a synchronized end, an unfinished line, a posthumous letter. Death and writing collapse into one inscription.","members":[1,2,4,6,7,8]},{"name":"The Vow That Outlives Its Keeping","laconic":"A promise persists beyond the loss it was meant to seal.","note":"Stands apart from the authorship cluster: here meaning lies in fidelity surviving the dead, not in death-as-text.","members":[5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Other Who Is The Self's Verdict","laconic":"A figure who is no person but the protagonist's reckoning.","note":"Each reading converts an apparent other—woman, summons, suicide—into a projection of the protagonist's own moral self-confrontation. The encountered figure is the verdict, not a character.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Soundstage As A Diorama Of Sweden","laconic":"Whole nations built inside the airless studio frame.","note":"Andersson's tableaux read the constructed studio set itself as a theory of national life — a sealed world fashioned room by room. The set is not background but argument.","members":[0,2,3,5]},{"name":"The Adman's Craft Turned Against Itself","laconic":"A career in advertising weaponized into critique.","note":"These readings hinge specifically on Andersson's commercial past — the polished persuasive frame inverted to indict the very world it once sold.","members":[1,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Occupation Filmed In Its Own Tense","note":"Both readings insist the film bears the timestamp of its making—the Intifada and the wall captured not retrospectively but inside the historical moment they document.","laconic":"Palestinian cinema shot inside the conflict's living present.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Showman Who Weaponizes Skepticism","laconic":"The performer of doubt mistakes spectacle for truth.","note":"Each reading frames a charismatic skeptic whose theatrical command of 'truth' is itself a con — debunking and disinformation become the same showman's act. Both Reeds and Mysterio sell mastery while peddling manufactured doubt.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Body Written By The Penal System","laconic":"Tattooed flesh as the State's scripture and ledger of punishment.","note":"Both readings treat Max Cady's marked skin as a text inscribed by the carceral system, vengeance literalized as a penal manuscript made flesh.","members":[0,1]},{"name":"The Body The State Condemned, Reclaimed","laconic":"Flesh marked for death wrested back through act and labor.","note":"Each treats the prisoner's body as the State's chosen object of erasure, then reframes survival — manual escape, the murmured doubt of guilt — as repossession of that condemned body.","members":[2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Solidarity As Scarcity's Unaffordable Counter-Logic","laconic":"Class loyalty priced as a luxury the system cannot permit.","note":"These readings cast solidarity not as triumphant but as economically taxed, privatized, or proven impossible under scarcity — the bond exists precisely to be exposed as unsustainable. Each frames collective loyalty against the individual ascent, the snitch, or the wage that dissolves it.","members":[0,1,5,9,11,12,13,15]},{"name":"Who Owns The Means Of Labor","laconic":"The real stake is who controls work, hiring, pensions.","note":"A tight code of 'the real stake is who controls X' — naming the hidden ownership question beneath plot: hiring, pensions, the union-mob pact over working bodies.","members":[4,6,8]},{"name":"The Privatized Fist Of Revolt","laconic":"A collective gesture captured and sold as individual style.","note":"Bender's raised fist and the house-beating heist crew both stage revolt that has been privatized — collective insurgency reduced to personal triumph against the system.","members":[10,14]},{"name":"The Underclass That Cannot Represent Itself","laconic":"The permanently marginal as unrepresentable, taxed, or buried labor.","note":"Marginal populations figured as labor that the narrative cannot fully voice — the tethered, the perpetual underdogs, the working-class hope subjected to a sexual tax.","members":[2,3,7]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Wife As Property In The Honor Economy","laconic":"Women circulated, decided, and spent within systems of male power.","note":"These readings expose marriage and femininity as economic and patriarchal transactions, where wives are bestowed, sabotaged, or sacrificed to sustain male honor and authority. The woman's will is structurally absent; she is the currency, never the agent.","members":[0,2,3,4,5,6,7]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The One At His Post Who Refused","laconic":"The sentry who disobeys the system from inside its machinery.","note":"Each reading invokes a real or analogized figure stationed within an apparatus of force who defects, disobeys, or refuses the computed/commanded verdict to preserve life. The trope binds them to a Petrov-like icon of conscientious refusal at the controls.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"De Chirico's Empty Piazza Of Stopped Time","laconic":"Metaphysical depopulated squares freeze the frame into uncanny suspension.","note":"Each reading invokes De Chirico's deserted architectural perspectives as the governing visual code, where emptied public space arrests time and breeds dread. The shared device is the metaphysical piazza, not mere stillness or composition.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Boy Who Photographs to Stay Real","laconic":"Mason's camera as a defense against his own erasure.","note":"Both readings cast Mason's photography not as hobby but as existential capture—seizing the unguarded instant to arrest his own vanishing across time.","members":[0,1]}]}
{"verdict":"reject","groups":[]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Father Who Cannot Answer Back","laconic":"Paternity survives only as image, absence, or hollow address.","note":"Each reading stages the father not as a person but as an unreachable surface — a god who never replies, a recognized image, a man without an unconscious. The child confronts a paternity that has been emptied into representation.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Tenderness Authentic Only As Performance","laconic":"Love proves real precisely when staged, bought, or lied into being.","note":"Each reading locates genuine affection inside its own falsification — the lie, the transaction, the learned skill is what makes tenderness true rather than what corrupts it.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Promised Refuge Filmed As Inescapable Trap","laconic":"Sites of hope shot to expose the prison they really are.","note":"Each reading takes a space coded as escape or salvation — school, classroom, Eden, sanctuary-city — and reveals the camera staging it as confinement or broken promise. The institution of rescue becomes the architecture of entrapment.","members":[0,2,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Critic's Contempt As Panic Over Female Pleasure","laconic":"Disdain for a film masks anxiety about its female audience.","note":"Each reading reframes critical or cultural dismissal as gendered backlash — the sneer at 'girl' media exposing a panic over women's enthusiasm and box-office power. The contempt is the symptom, not the verdict.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Director's Banishment Authored As Confessional Apparatus","laconic":"Exile and excommunication encoded into the film's own confessing form.","note":"Each reading treats a director's pariahdom — exile, Cannes excommunication, festival banishment — not as biography but as the film's structuring confessional device. The auteur's expulsion becomes the apparatus through which the work speaks itself.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Bus As New Deal Commonwealth","laconic":"Depression-era transit as the people's coalition rehearsing democratic solidarity.","note":"Both readings cast the Capra bus as a microcosm of Popular Front fellowship, singing itself into a New Deal public.","members":[1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Dissenting Report That Indicts The System","laconic":"The minority's verdict reframed as freedom's last suppressed voice.","note":"Both readings seize the film's titular 'minority report' as a political cipher for dissent crushed by consensus. The same interpretive move, differing only in whether dissent is manufactured or sacred.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Plantation That Became the Prison","laconic":"Incarceration as slavery's unbroken afterlife, time itself the chain.","note":"Both readings of Time (2020) decode the carceral system as a continuation of plantation bondage — Angola literally, time figuratively. The hidden ontology is that emancipation never arrived.","members":[0,1]},{"name":"The Cell Where Time Is the Warden","laconic":"Shawshank's true sentence is duration, not walls.","note":"Reads the prison not as place but as time itself — the slow erosion of years as the real instrument of punishment.","members":[2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The City Named For Its Sin, Not Its Map","laconic":"The place-name is moral epistemology, never geography.","note":"Each title christens a locale by its corruption or its curse rather than its coordinates — the name encodes a knowledge of helplessness, not a location. Roger Rabbit's noir-skinned Toontown belongs by the same logic.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Genocidal Sentimentalist Who Did The Math","laconic":"Thanos as cold demographic logic wearing the mask of grief and necessity.","note":"Every reading recasts Thanos's purge as rationalized actuarial reason — eugenics, sustainability, spreadsheet economics, lifeboat ethics — softened by his own tears. Even [5]'s inversion lives inside the same calculus.","members":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Everyday Object As Instrument","laconic":"Domestic noise reworked into musique concrète.","note":"Both films treat ambient and household sound as deliberate composition, casting kitchen clatter and resort racket as a score in the lineage of Schaeffer's musique concrète.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Degraded Image As Necromantic Channel","laconic":"Analog decay becomes the conduit through which the dead return.","note":"Low-fidelity video and spirit photography converge: degradation is not loss but a haunted medium, the static through which death speaks. The VHS cassette becomes a literal body of analog death.","members":[0,4,5]},{"name":"Degraded Texture As The Argument For Truth","laconic":"Grain and analog flaw authenticate the image as evidence.","note":"Here degradation is epistemological, not supernatural — the worn image as recovered folk artifact, ontological equalizer, or document of manufactured memory. The aesthetics of decay stake a claim about what is real.","members":[1,2,6]},{"name":"The Eulogy For The Vanishing Format","laconic":"A medium mourned on the eve of its obsolescence.","note":"Ringu read as a wake for VHS before DVD; the dying format itself is the subject of grief.","members":[3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Man Who Serves The Principle, Not The Person","laconic":"His loyalty is to the rule itself, never the individual.","note":"A protagonist's integrity is reframed as devotion to an abstract principle that paradoxically makes him the most useful instrument of the powers he serves. The honest man's incorruptibility is exactly what the system exploits.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Closed Circuit With No Exit","laconic":"The loop names itself — a circuit that consumes and never releases.","note":"These readings hinge on the title-as-circuit: a closed, self-feeding loop (network, virus, glamour, compulsion) from which nothing escapes. The pun on 'Ring/circle/circuit' is the binding code.","members":[0,2,3,5]},{"name":"Hollywood Translating An Untranslatable Dread","laconic":"The American remake as anxious mistranslation of foreign horror.","note":"A standalone reading about cross-cultural adaptation anxiety, distinct from the self-naming-circuit code.","members":[4]},{"name":"The Single Line Binding Murder To Art","laconic":"The title names one continuous thread tying killing to aesthetics.","note":"Rope as an uncut line fusing crime and artistry — a binding device, not a closed circuit of compulsion.","members":[1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Power That Cannot Outrun Death","laconic":"Each fantasy of mastery collapses into the one irreversible limit.","note":"Time-travel, mutant healing, transformation, and the search for eternity all converge on mortality as the truth no power escapes. Death is reframed not as defeat but as the secret subject these films were always about.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Couturier As Unacknowledged Sovereign","laconic":"The master tailor whose authorship is hidden, denied, or absolute.","note":"Each reading turns the atelier into a site of authorship and power — the uncredited hand behind glamour, the genius forbidden his signature, the despot of cloth. The garment becomes a contested name.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Cut That Withholds The Climax","laconic":"Editing weaponized to refuse the spectacle violence usually delivers.","note":"Both readings cast Haneke's montage as an ethical refusal: where Hollywood cutting builds toward cathartic release, here duration and elision deny the audience its expected payoff. The edit becomes accusation rather than gratification.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mute Fish Confessor","laconic":"The eel as silent confidant that hears without demanding penance.","note":"All three read the eel as a non-judging listener — the creature that absorbs confession because it cannot ask for it. The animal becomes the wordless surrogate for the wife, the priest, the human he can no longer trust.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Auteur As Tyrant Within","laconic":"The visionary director read as outsized creative megalomaniac.","note":"Both readings cast the artistic mastermind figure as a Wellesian colossus of ambition and control. They converge on the same code: directorial vision as sublimated, self-aggrandizing power.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Served Who Quietly Becomes Sovereign","laconic":"Service reverses into mastery; the dependent commands.","note":"Each reading detects a dialectical flip in caretaking or service relations—pupil over teacher, server over served, the fed dictating to the feeder. The meal and the lesson become arenas of negotiated power.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The City As A Body In Mourning","laconic":"Grief becomes civic, the polity itself the bereaved subject.","note":"Each reading treats the city not as backdrop but as the mourner—or the thing that refuses to mourn. Loss is mapped onto the body politic, making collective grief the true protagonist.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Negation That Affirms","laconic":"'No' as the title-word whose refusal becomes the film's true assertion.","note":"Each reading mines the same device: a 'no' lodged in the title that, far from emptying meaning, generates the film's affirmative core — naming an era, saving a life, defining a politics.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Freedom Disguised As Fate","laconic":"Sartrean bad faith: choices masked as destiny, abandonment, or predetermined exits.","note":"Each reading exposes a character (or system) dressing chosen commitment — or its refusal — in the language of inevitability. The cluster coheres as an existentialist indictment: the alibi of fate concealing the burden of choice.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Snow That Betrays Its Soundstage","laconic":"Winter manufactured, confined, falling only where the camera permits.","note":"Snow as artifice bounded by the set's edge — a furnace pretending to be cold, a Selznick soundstage, a single Parisian arrondissement. The weather is a fabricated enclosure, not a climate.","members":[0,1,4]},{"name":"The Frozen World As Externalized Interior","laconic":"Snowbound landscape stands in for what cannot be outrun within.","note":"The icebound setting becomes the externalization of an inner condition — blindness, entrapment, a frozen order that must be shattered rather than escaped.","members":[2,5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Composed Face As Inscribed Female Suffering","laconic":"Feminine self-possession reread as the body's site of socially-coerced anguish.","note":"Each reading takes a woman's outward composure and reads it as a surface inscribed by suffering — honor economy, masochistic pact, hysteria. The 'composed face' becomes the legible mark of disciplined or somatized pain.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Fantasy With No Outside","laconic":"Dream and waking fuse until no reality remains to escape to.","note":"Both readings name the same Buñuelian device: surrealism so seamlessly integrated that the boundary between fantasy and reality dissolves, leaving no stable 'real' to anchor the dream. The disciplining-into-invisibility and the no-outside are two faces of one code.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"Elegance Worn As Armor","laconic":"The dandy's charm and frivolity are a defensive, weaponized performance.","note":"Across these readings, surface elegance and frivolous polish are reinterpreted as protective hardware — charm performed as armor, frivolity as disguised seriousness. The dandy's style is never decorative but defensive.","members":[0,3,4,6]},{"name":"The Costume Of A Doomed Leisure Class","laconic":"Finery as the uniform of a vanishing, service-built aristocracy.","note":"Here clothing and party reads as the insignia of a leisure class — its single interchangeable body, its eternal return, its built-on-service foundation. The garment indexes a whole social order on its way out.","members":[1,2,5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Cockpit As The Soldier's Sealed Body","laconic":"The capsule/cockpit reads as the veteran's bunkered, wounded, or armored self.","note":"Each reading collapses an enclosed vehicle or chamber into the soldier-protagonist's own body — bunkered, hospitalized, dismembered, or cocooned. The capsule is not a machine but the self made into a shell.","members":[0,1,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Improvisation Against The Franchise Machine","laconic":"The unscripted moment rebels against corporate predestination.","note":"These readings cast improvisation as a counter-force to franchise determinism, the loose moment that escapes the studio's plotting engine. The Ragnarok anti-imperial reading [1] stands apart as a different code about smuggled politics.","members":[0,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Satanic Panic As Reaganite Repression","laconic":"Eighties moral panic decoded as projected national hypocrisy.","note":"Each reading recasts the era's Satanic/evangelical panic as a screen for repressed appetites and conservative backlash made flesh. The horror is American hypocrisy externalized as the demonic.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The West Crowns The Cage It Cannot Open","laconic":"Festival acclaim as aestheticized complicity with the artist's imprisonment.","note":"Each reading frames Western prestige not as liberation but as a connoisseurship of the constrained Iranian auteur — applause that decorates the cell rather than breaking it. The prize becomes both tribute and alibi.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Pop Voice That Sutures The Divided","laconic":"A diva's song stands in for a unity politics denies.","note":"Teresa Teng's voice becomes the shared citizenship of a scattered Greater China, binding migrants whom borders and politics keep apart. The reading treats popular song as the only commons left.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Care Enacted, Never Declared","laconic":"Ethics proven by wordless tending, not by speech or vow.","note":"These readings locate morality in silent, unspoken acts of care—loyalty and tending that refuse declaration, obligation, or articulation. The ethical agent is recognized precisely by what stays unsaid.","members":[0,1,3,4]},{"name":"Care Against The Ledger Of Property","laconic":"An ethics of tending indicts the calculus of ownership.","note":"Here care is positioned explicitly against an economic-juridical order—frontier property, the logic of calculation. The moral force lies in care as a counter-system to value-as-extraction.","members":[2,5]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Virtuoso Who Refuses The Applause","laconic":"Mastery proven by the refusal to perform its own triumph.","note":"Both readings figure excellence as a deliberate withdrawal from the climactic flourish — the assassin abandoning the kill, the score denying the swell. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Screen as the Only Real","laconic":"Mediation displaces the real; the broadcast becomes the sole accessible world.","note":"Each reading insists screens don't represent reality but supplant it—nation, psyche, and pack alike can only encounter themselves as transmission, with the monitor as both shield and cell.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Airport Where He Witnesses His Own Death","laconic":"The terminal as eternal return of self-witnessed death.","note":"Both readings fix on the airport as a site of compulsive repetition where Cole loops back to watch himself die. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Pacific As Ironic Peace","laconic":"The named ocean of peace becomes the theater of war.","note":"Both readings exploit the etymology of 'Pacific' — peace — and turn it against itself, the calm sea masking conflict or concealing it. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Doll's House That Watches Its Maker","laconic":"Miniature-making collapses into the maker's own captivity.","note":"Each reading reframes the diorama or model as a sovereign frame that contains and controls its supposed author, turning craft into entrapment. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Duration Itself Becomes The Weapon","laconic":"Held time, not action, is the film's true assault.","note":"Each reading locates meaning in protracted duration — the lingered face, the unbearable runtime, the marathon fight — treating stretched time as the active aggressor rather than mere staging.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mirror That Hands You Another's Self","laconic":"Borrowed reflections transmit desire, damnation, and tenderness between bodies.","note":"Each reading turns an act of mirroring—stolen clothes, the convent glass, applied makeup—into the transfer of one person's interior life onto another. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Commons Enclosed Into Private Hands","laconic":"What was shared becomes owned — water, air, dream, survival, mind.","note":"A recurring move that reads the film's central resource — reservoir, air, consciousness, the apocalypse — as an enclosure of a public good into private property. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Long Take As Congealed Time","laconic":"Duration filmed until waiting becomes a material, authenticated substance.","note":"Each reading treats the long take not as style but as time made tangible—slowness solidified, waiting congealed, duration offered up for canonization. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Long Take That Refuses To Cut","laconic":"Unbroken duration as a moral and bodily contract with the viewer.","note":"Each reading treats the long take not as virtuosity but as an ethical wager — denying the cut to bind us to witness, family, or fate. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Non-Place As True Setting","laconic":"Transit zones and anonymous interiors become the film's real subject.","note":"These readings locate meaning in Augé's non-places — terminals, clubs, cabins, freeways — where identity and geography dissolve and grief or alienation finds no anchor. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Camera's Constraint Becomes Its Cosmology","laconic":"A formal limitation, embraced, transmutes into the film's governing meaning.","note":"Each reading locates a production or compositional restriction — refusal to move, crew kept off-frame, surveillance forced by circumstance — and argues that constraint authored the film's metaphysics. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Healer Treating His Own Wound","laconic":"The therapist's patient is secretly himself.","note":"Each reading collapses the healer/patient divide: the analyst's cure of another is really a displaced self-treatment, the wound mirrored back on the one wielding the remedy.","members":[0,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Frame Painted As A Rothko Field","laconic":"Cinema staged inside color-field voids of saturated, annihilating abstraction.","note":"Each reading recasts the screen as a Rothko canvas — actors and dramas suspended in blocks of pure color and devouring darkness. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Winnipeg Wearing Tehran's Face","laconic":"A prairie city only legible once renamed as elsewhere.","note":"All three readings converge on the same device: Winnipeg made visible only by being doubled with Tehran, the immigrant's map superimposed on real geography. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Soil That Records Exploitation","laconic":"Earth and mud as physical ledgers of unpaid Black labor.","note":"Each reading turns ground itself—red dirt, mud—into a material record of debt, caste, and exploited labor. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Title Names The Parasite, Not The Host","laconic":"Brood-parasite titles that withhold who steals whose nest.","note":"Each reading treats the title as a code of parasitism—the cuckoo, the parasite—that refuses to fix which party is the thief and which the nest. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"Postwar Japan's Disavowed Inheritance In A Child","laconic":"The illegitimate or doubled child carries the nation's repressed history.","note":"Children become the somatic ledger of Japan's postwar reckoning: assimilation versus return, the wronged welcoming the wrong's daughter. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"There Is No Self Behind the Broadcast","laconic":"The televisual signal devours interiority; only transmission remains.","note":"Each reading collapses the human into the broadcast — no protagonist, no self, no outside, just the medium pulsing where a soul should be. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Engineered Body As Argument","laconic":"A fabricated creature built to carry a thesis.","note":"Both readings treat Okja's manufactured animal as a designed instrument—engineered either to be killable or to manufacture sincerity. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Real Place Cast As Sacred Or Dead City","laconic":"Actual locations conscripted to play eternal, tomb-like, or holy ground.","note":"Matera, Sabbioneta, and Etna are filmed not as themselves but as charged emblems — Jerusalem, an ideal city as tomb, a soul turned to ash. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Oedipal Triangle Restaged As Desire","laconic":"Family bonds rewritten as forbidden, incestuous, or parental erotic charge.","note":"Each reading decodes a family configuration—mother, sibling, parental bed, shared lover—as the return of the repressed Oedipal/incestuous wish. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Heir As The System's Inherited Rot","laconic":"Privileged scions embody a society's foundational corruption made flesh.","note":"Each reading treats the spoiled heir or chaebol successor not as a character but as the literal incarnation of structural impunity—rage, sin, and idleness crystallized into a bloodline. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Town That Digests Its Own Fear","laconic":"Derry as organism that metabolizes repression and complicity.","note":"Each reading recasts the monster as the town itself — a civic body that eats, digests, or remembers its own repression. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Sacred Score For An Absent God","laconic":"Choral and divine music scores worlds God has already vacated.","note":"These readings hear sacred music—choir, organ, lullaby, the gods' own voice—as the soundtrack of abandonment, mourning a divinity that watches indifferently or has fled. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Lavish Budget Spent Toward Pure Colour","laconic":"Record-breaking expense converted into chromatic spectacle as the film's real subject.","note":"Both readings treat the famously enormous budget not as backstage trivia but as an aesthetic argument: money becomes saturated color, spectacle as the point of the spending. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Wife Authoring Her Husband's Madness","laconic":"Alma's pregnant body and diary generate the haunting, not demons.","note":"Both readings relocate the film's supernatural source into Alma — her dreaming pregnancy, her diary — making her the true author of the demonology. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Calendar Unit That Names The Lie","laconic":"Leisure-time labels expose the false promise of free time.","note":"Each reading treats a unit of off-hours — weekend, holiday, happy hour — as an ironic naming that betrays leisure's emptiness or impossibility. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Myth That Devours Its Witness","laconic":"Belief converts the investigator into the legend she sought to debunk.","note":"Both readings frame Helen's fate as the myth's self-perpetuation: the skeptic must be consumed and reborn so the legend lives. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Desire Smuggled Past The Censor's Code","laconic":"Hollywood's Production Code forces eroticism into cipher, innuendo, and verbal evasion.","note":"These readings all locate sexual meaning displaced by the Breen/Production Code into dialogue, double-talk, and coded figures. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Place That Is Banishment Made Geography","laconic":"Locations stand in for exile, the world remapped as banishment.","note":"Each reading converts a setting—town, port, province, seaside resort—into the spatial form of exile or banishment, so geography literally embodies the condition of being cast out. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Goldberg Repetition With A Difference","laconic":"Gould's two recordings as key to films of variation.","note":"Each reading invokes Glenn Gould's twin Goldberg recordings (or fugue) to frame a film as theme-and-variation — the same material replayed with a difference. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Munich As The Built Cage Of History","laconic":"The city's architecture confesses what the story leaves unspoken.","note":"Each reading treats Munich's physical fabric—tenement, gasworks, bunker, studio-ghosts—as a semiotic prison: place hardened into condition, walls speaking the verdict the plot withholds.","members":[0,1,2,3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Eyewear That Encodes Ideology","laconic":"Glasses and lenses as the optics of belief and false consciousness.","note":"Each reading treats eyewear not as costume but as an apparatus of ideology — the lens through which law, capital, or false consciousness is literally seen or unseen. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Sibling Locked Inside The Family Cage","laconic":"Incest as refusal to leave the maternal dyad.","note":"Both readings frame Lucille's incest not as desire but as a frozen inability to exit the family enclosure. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Acquittal That Settles Nothing","laconic":"Formal exoneration leaves the moral guilt intact and circulating.","note":"Both readings treat acquittal as a hollow legal gesture: the verdict clears the record but not the conscience, and the aesthete or accused walks free into unresolved guilt. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Citizen's Casually Privatized Arsenal","laconic":"Lethal force decentralized into ordinary hands, frictionless and ambient.","note":"Each reading sees firearms not as plot devices but as a banalized civic condition — guns as background infrastructure of the self-armed populace. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Camera That Records Its Own Witness","laconic":"Self-recording footage becomes confession, surveillance, and self-incrimination.","note":"Each reading treats the consumer camcorder/webcam as a device that captures the subject testifying against or exposing themselves. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Stardom Demands A Human Sacrifice","laconic":"One must be immolated so another can ascend.","note":"Each reading frames fame as a sacrificial economy: the new idol's birth is purchased by an old idol's death or immolation. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Atonement Paid In The Coin Of The Sin","laconic":"Redemption sought through the very instruments that incurred the guilt.","note":"These readings frame each film around substitutionary or compensatory atonement — sin and its remedy sharing the same tools, sacraments, or theology. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Withheld Event Is The Whole Argument","laconic":"What the film refuses to show becomes its thesis.","note":"Each reading locates the film's meaning in a deliberate elision — an exile's cause, a never-shown meeting, a death held offscreen. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Voice That Betrays Its Image","laconic":"Narration and image at war over who authors meaning.","note":"Each reading stages a fracture between the speaking voice and the seen image — the voice authors, fails to see, or blinds. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Borrowed Song That Speaks The Unspeakable","laconic":"A foreign or pop ballad voices what the film's characters cannot.","note":"Each reading hinges on an imported or diegetic song—Western ballad, Cantonese pop, American standard, Scottish air—that becomes the true confessional voice of the film, naming a desire or grief the dialogue withholds.","members":[1,2,3,5,7,8]},{"name":"The Allusive Title As Buried Source Text","laconic":"A classical or generic phrase reframes the film as old story.","note":"These readings recast the film through an inherited template—Bizet's Carmen, the 'green plums/bamboo horse' idiom, the 'ambush from ten directions' figure—treating love as encirclement or untransferable past via a prior code.","members":[2,4,6]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Citizen Reduced To A File","laconic":"Surveillance dissolves the person into cipher, serial number, dossier.","note":"Each reading turns the named subject into an administrative abstraction — a codename, a number, a file — where the apparatus counts people rather than seeing them. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"Talk Engineered As Anti-Spectacle Doctrine","laconic":"Rohmer's moral tales make conversation the deliberate refusal of cinematic show.","note":"Both readings frame Rohmer's dialogue as a programmatic stance — talk weaponized against spectacle, rooted in critic-formed habits. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The West Canonizes By Refusing To Read","laconic":"Western acclaim universalizes the foreign film to evade its specificity.","note":"Each reading exposes the same critical move: the West embraces an Asian film by recasting its cultural particulars as universal, aestheticized, or exotic—praising precisely by not reading. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Reception That Tamed The Dish","laconic":"Praise domesticates a film by eating around its sharpest meaning.","note":"Each reading indicts the critical/popular reception itself as a containment device — comfort-food framing that consumes the surface while skipping the unease the film actually serves.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Abdication As Theological Act","laconic":"Stepping down recast as the soul's highest negative gesture.","note":"All three read Benedict's resignation not as failure but as a deliberate, almost mystical renunciation — withdrawal as the truest doctrine. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Water That Keeps Reclaiming The Drowned","laconic":"Drowning as a wound the film cannot stop revisiting.","note":"Each reading treats water/drowning not as event but as compulsion — a trauma the narrative is doomed to circle back toward. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Hokusai's Wave Set In Motion","laconic":"The Great Wave reanimated as living, ambivalent sea.","note":"Both readings invoke Hokusai's woodblock wave as the iconographic source for an animated ocean that both nurtures and threatens. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Theme That Loves In Secret","laconic":"A recurring musical phrase carries a love its bearer cannot speak.","note":"Each reading hears a returning motif as the cipher of a concealed, lifelong devotion — Proust's little phrase made flesh. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Marriage Plot Sold As Copyright","laconic":"Jo's only true vow is to retain her royalties.","note":"Each reading replaces the romantic ending with a contractual one, treating authorship and ownership as the real consummation Jo consents to. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Turing Test As Dramatic Engine","laconic":"Films staged as imitation games where minds prove indistinguishable.","note":"These readings invoke Turing's imitation game as a structuring device—where the question is whether a mind can be detected, faked, or disproven. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"One War's Rubble Standing In For Another","laconic":"A conflict re-staged through the geography of a different war.","note":"The cinematic body of one occupation is filmed onto the location of another, making the substitute place a haunted double.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Camera Itself Becomes The Motion","laconic":"Mobile, machine-bound velocity made into the film's argument.","note":"Movement is not depicted but performed — the lightweight or machine-mounted camera makes speed and motion the very theme, dissolving authorship into kinesis.","members":[0,1,2]},{"name":"The New Wave As Doomed Economy","laconic":"The movement named by the necessity that breaks it.","note":"Two readings treat 'New Wave' not as aesthetic triumph but as condition — born of economic constraint, fated like a wave to break to exist.","members":[3,4]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Confinement That Betrays Its Own Making","laconic":"A film's locked interiors read as traces of a forbidden shoot.","note":"Both readings treat the claustrophobic apartment not as theme but as forensic evidence — the diegetic confinement bleeds from the real conditions of a clandestine production. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Knight Is Time Made Green","laconic":"Green precedes and outlasts the man; the foe is mortality.","note":"Both readings dissolve the Green Knight from antagonist into impersonal duration—color and time wearing flesh that men cannot outlive. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Real Erupts Through The Document","laconic":"Archival or re-enacted footage breaks open the buried, repressed Real.","note":"Each reading treats a documentary device — re-enactment, archive, newsreel — not as record but as a rupture through which the repressed Real returns into private experience. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Scar That Mirrors The Hunter","laconic":"A wound or scar marks the pursuer as twin to his enemy.","note":"Two readings of The Searchers cast Scar as Ethan's dark mirror — manifest destiny and avenger fused in one disfigurement. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Road Mapped Only By Improvising It","laconic":"Wenders films that script themselves at the speed of travel.","note":"Each reading treats improvisation not as technique but as the film's governing epistemology — meaning discovered en route, never pre-planned. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Predation Dressed As Cosmic Law","laconic":"The food chain rebranded as theology, sanctifying the strong devouring the weak.","note":"Each reading reframes raw predation or greed as a sacred ordering principle — natural selection elevated to scripture, mercy abolished by metaphysical decree. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Cinema As Rite Against History","laconic":"Film stages exorcism or resurrection, conjuring power to undo the past.","note":"Each reading casts cinema as a quasi-religious ritual — exorcism, Lazarus machine — wielded to confront, purge, or reverse history. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Borrowed Song That Speaks The Unspeakable","laconic":"Music becomes the confession the character cannot voice directly.","note":"Across these readings, song stands in for feeling too raw or unbearable to say aloud — the performance as displaced declaration. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Biopic Whose Subject Never Existed","laconic":"Lives portrayed as masks concealing nothing but more masks.","note":"Each reading attacks the biopic's founding promise — a stable self beneath the performance — by insisting there is only surface. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Unwaged Labor Beneath The Wage","laconic":"Domestic care read as the invisible work sustaining waged economy.","note":"Each reading reframes women's reproductive and domestic labor as the uncounted foundation of the wage relation. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Hypertrophied Body As Reagan-Era America","laconic":"The muscled physique read as 1980s national ideology made flesh.","note":"Each treats the engorged or sculpted body as a cipher for Reagan-era America — its industry, doctrine, and excess literalized in muscle. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Assimilated Voice As Colonial Mask","laconic":"Altering one's voice or self enacts an internalized supremacist gaze.","note":"Several readings treat the modulated or 'polished' voice as a symptom of internalized colonial power — speech as the site where assimilation and supremacy are negotiated. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Prosthetic Body As Phallus Against Castration","laconic":"Augmented limbs and implants disavow the wound they secretly name.","note":"Each reads a technological or bodily augmentation—implant, cable-arm, armor, prosthetic—as a fetish-phallus warding off castration. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Father As Absent Modernist Ideal","laconic":"The faceless paternal authority survives only as a structure to inherit.","note":"All three read Columbus through the unseen father: a modernist ideal rendered faceless, whose heir can only translate or fail to build. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Woman Taxed By The Reputation Economy","laconic":"Female honor becomes currency the plot spends and punishes.","note":"These readings frame the woman as collateral in a social economy of reputation—her standing weighed, sacrificed, or taxed by those calculating whose name is worth saving. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Nostalgia's Beauty As Moral Anesthetic","laconic":"The warm palette numbs us to the injustice it depicts.","note":"Each reading treats nostalgia's loveliness as a deception — beauty that aestheticizes injustice, comforts where it should disturb, or stretches loss across light-years. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Documentary That Shows Its Own Strings","laconic":"Nonfiction films that expose their apparatus to authenticate the fiction.","note":"Each reading turns the documentary's self-betraying machinery into its truth-claim: the camera, the staging, the withheld fact, the release form become the very devices that earn belief. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Costume That Becomes The Person","laconic":"Identity outsourced to a frictionless accessory.","note":"Both readings locate selfhood in a detachable surface — the hat, the substitutable role. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Repeated Name As Variable In A Loop","laconic":"One name iterated across versions until structure dissolves into permutation.","note":"Both readings of In Another Country treat the shared name not as character but as a variable cycled through narrative loops, the repetition itself becoming the puzzle's solvent. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Border Region Cast As Itself","laconic":"Alsace-Rhine frontier locations playing the contested boundary they embody.","note":"These readings find films using Franco-German border geography—Colmar, the Rhine, an Alsatian fortress, a Bavarian castle—as a location that performs its own historical contestedness. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Dread As A Manufactured Apparatus","laconic":"Fear isn't depicted — it's engineered by a named cinematic technique.","note":"Each reading locates dread in a specific production mechanism — the lighting, the framing of absence, the coverage, the countdown — treating fear as fabricated rather than felt. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mechanism As Mortal Reckoning","laconic":"Clockwork and automata as confessions of obsolescence and reversed death.","note":"Each reading treats a precision mechanism — automaton, watchmaker's craft — as the owner's attempt to audit, arrest, or reverse his own decay. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mask That Confesses Its Own Apparatus","laconic":"Each reading treats Borat's device as self-naming admission of its mechanism.","note":"All three locate the film's truth in a screen, fetish, or mask that openly declares the artifice doing the work—the bear, the Baywatch image, the false name as confession.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Unresolved Tone As Metaphysics","laconic":"Dissonant, suspended sound becomes the film's whole cosmology.","note":"Both readings treat unresolved or microtonal sound design as a metaphysical proposition rather than mere atmosphere — the alien and the divine voiced through tones that refuse to settle. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Land As Stern Salvation","laconic":"Harsh Yorkshire terrain that humbles, then heals its men.","note":"Both readings cast the Pennine landscape as a withholding deity whose grace arrives only through earthbound human labor and touch. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Title That Stays A Verb","laconic":"To live as ongoing action, never settling into a noun.","note":"Each reading seizes on a title that names living-as-verb, refusing completion or nominalization. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The World That Continues Past Its Own Damnation","laconic":"An already-ended world replays the motions of its own doom.","note":"These readings share a code of damnation as a state already achieved rather than approaching — the end has happened, yet the film grinds on. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Civil War Films Cannot Name","laconic":"Lebanon's conflict displaced into fiction, geography, or proxy tribunal.","note":"These readings share a single code: the Lebanese civil war rendered unnameable, staged through an invented country, a substitute landscape, a diaspora's buried memory, or a courtroom standing in for the truth commission that never happened. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"Silence As The State's Seizure Of The Voice","laconic":"Enforced quiet becomes the sovereign's grip on the body and household.","note":"These readings cast silence not as absence but as a political imposition — the surveilled, the listened-to, the body forbidden to make sound. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Title Names A Wiring Diagram, Not Kinship","laconic":"'Network' as cold circuitry masquerading as human connection.","note":"Both readings seize the word 'network' and expose it as a lie of intimacy — a schematic of wires, not a community or a product.","members":[1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Motiveless Kill As Freedom","laconic":"Murder without reason becomes the existential proof of liberty.","note":"Both readings cast the unmotivated killing as a gratuitous act—violence stripped of cause becomes a pure assertion of freedom. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"New Mexico Plays the Dying West","laconic":"The state as stand-in for a frontier already gone.","note":"Each reading casts New Mexico not as itself but as a substitute landscape — Texas, the grave, the vanishing frontier, cosmic indifference — making the location-double the very sign of the West's death. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Father As Absent Law Programming The Son","laconic":"The vanished father returns as structuring lack, inheritance, or symptom.","note":"Each reading locates the father not as presence but as a gap, code, or law the child must inherit, repeat, or be destroyed by. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Failed Tolstoy in His Study","laconic":"The provincial intellectual whose unwritten work indicts his moral cowardice.","note":"Aydın reads as the literary-secular man of letters whose grand renunciation never comes — Tolstoy minus the sacrifice, Casaubon's key never written. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Camera That Manufactures Its Own Haunting","laconic":"Surveillance does not capture the demon—surveillance summons it.","note":"All three read Paranormal Activity's recording apparatus as the generative source of dread rather than its witness: the timecode, the bureaucratic ritual, and the camera itself become the haunting. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Welfare State Audits Its Own Promise","laconic":"Nordic social democracy as a contract being quietly reckoned with.","note":"These readings personify the welfare state as institution measuring, forgetting, or auditing its founding promise of engineered happiness. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Crime As Wage Labor In Disguise","laconic":"The genre thriller reread as a study of work.","note":"Each reading dissolves crime, action, or violence into labor — insisting the true subject is the wage, the job, the working life. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Archive Built Over A Body","laconic":"The archive as a tomb housing what it cannot recover.","note":"Each reading treats the archive (papers, files, dossiers, fragments) as a sepulchral structure raised over a dead or absent body — its order standing in for what it can neither restore nor read. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The Killing Art Mastered As Calligraphy","laconic":"Lethal skill rendered as a contemplative discipline of the brush.","note":"Films [0] and [1] both frame martial violence through the aesthetics of calligraphy — the stroke and the kill as one mastered art.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Acclaim That Grants Permission To Enjoy Bond","laconic":"Praise as license: critics needed an excuse to love the franchise.","note":"These readings recast critical acclaim as a permission slip — the film hailed not for itself but because the audience or era needed sanction to take Bond seriously again. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Respectability As The Bourgeois Mask","laconic":"The civilized front as armor concealing class, decay, the real.","note":"These readings treat the respectable surface — manners, powder, the bourgeois face — as a defensive mask over what it disavows: arrival, decay, surplus, the Real. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Hong Kong As Caste, Exile As Equalizer","laconic":"Belonging in Hong Kong is rank; only emigration dissolves the hierarchy.","note":"Both readings treat 'Hongkonger' as a status to be passed for or escaped, with the colonial caste collapsing only on neutral foreign soil. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The City Cast As Another City","laconic":"One metropolis impersonates another, the disguise itself becoming the meaning.","note":"Each reading turns a location's stand-in role into interpretation: doubling as counterfeit, replica, or the joke of authenticity. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Composure As Survival's Manic Armor","laconic":"Unflappable poise reread as defense forged by annihilating trauma.","note":"Each reading recodes a woman's calm not as strength but as a defensive structure built atop survived violence—repetition, identification, and composure all serve the same warding function.","members":[0,1,2,3]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Mind That Loses Its Own Map","laconic":"Memory dissolves; the self becomes a blueprint no longer legible to its author.","note":"Each reading frames cognitive decline as the loss of an internal cartography — the engineer's blueprint, the read-aloud mind, the psychiatrist's drawn map. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Soundstage That Rebuilds Feudal Japan","laconic":"Postwar studios resurrect a feudal order their nation just buried.","note":"These readings see the constructed set itself — Kyoto and Toho stages, a burned castle, a tatami den — as postwar Japan re-erecting and embalming a feudal world it has supposedly outgrown. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Aesthete Sovereign Who Forfeits Power","laconic":"Rulers who choose beauty over governance, and lose the realm.","note":"Each reading frames an Indian aristocrat as a king consumed by art and refinement while his dominion slips away — the sovereign as decadent aesthete rather than ruler. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Father Worn As Inherited Armor","laconic":"Paternal legacy worn on the body as protection, wound, and weapon.","note":"Each reading turns a worn object—helmet, armor, skin—into the father's failed or weaponized inheritance literally donned by the child. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Graffiti Tag As Authorial Signature","laconic":"Street-art mark-making reframes who authors the hero.","note":"Both readings cast Miles's tagging as the legitimating creative act that claims the suit and the mantle, treating graffiti as a lineage of authorship rather than vandalism.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Clerk Who Keeps the Quiet Ledger","laconic":"Bureaucratic figures whose deadpan record-keeping masks unspoken desolation.","note":"Each reading casts its subject as a clerk-figure — narrator, mourner, or functionary — whose measured, ledger-keeping deadpan conceals a quiet desperation. {"verdict":"multi","groups":[{"name":"The City That Never Lets You Arrive","laconic":"Vehicles cross a sprawl that defers destination into endless motion.","note":"Collateral and Speed turn Los Angeles into a road without arrival, a sealed transit that mistakes movement for progress.","members":[0,3,4]},{"name":"The Freeway As Murder Of The City","laconic":"The car-future is built atop the corpse of public transit.","note":"Roger Rabbit's conspiracy reads infrastructure as villainy — the master builder erasing one city to impose another.","members":[1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"Gold As Moral Test, Not Mere Loot","laconic":"Treasure becomes an ethical instrument that exposes what men truly worship.","note":"Each reading refuses gold as plot-MacGuffin, treating it instead as a device that forces moral or theological reckoning — bullion that judges its possessors rather than enriching them.","members":[0,1,2]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Brushstroke Revolt Against Photoreal Polish","laconic":"Animation that flaunts painterly texture to defy CGI's frictionless smoothness.","note":"Both readings frame the film as an aesthetic insurrection — visible craft and painterly surface deployed against the photoreal pipeline's seamless gloss. Index 2 names the smoothness as a target but reads it economically, not as painterly rebellion, so it stands alone.","members":[0,1]}]}

{"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Lone Woman Reading The Institution's Case","laconic":"Female investigator whose intuition outpaces and is exploited by the apparatus.","note":"Each reading frames a solitary woman inside an investigative institution whose method—listening, intuiting, profiling—is both her power and the thing the state outsources to her. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Murder Authored By The Cut","laconic":"No killer acts; the splice itself commits the crime.","note":"Each reading relocates agency from character to editing: the murder is an effect of montage, not of a hand. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Camera As The Eye Of An Absent God","laconic":"The roving lens stands in for a god who isn't there.","note":"Each reading transmutes camera movement or framing into a theological presence — a disembodied, godlike vantage built precisely on the absence of any body to anchor it. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Spanish Desert as Buried Truth","laconic":"Arid Iberian landscape reads as a nation's repressed or interred underside.","note":"Each reading transmutes a Spanish wasteland into psychic terrain — the repressed Mediterranean unconscious, an open grave, a man's interior wilderness. {"verdict":"code","groups":[{"name":"The Vacant Dwelling As Speculative Economy","laconic":"Empty apartments read as the hollow architecture of real-estate bubbles.","note":"Each reading treats the unoccupied home not as setting but as a sign of capital's vacancy — property built for value, not habitation.
